history.author: Appsara
history.description: Initial version created based on the confirmed screen designs

purpose: This document explains the purpose of EMS's Depot Activity Booking Query details.
features: Booking Query Function allows the user to query & view Booking Details without being able to edit data.

events.description: Opens the Booking Query screen in a new tab, showing the booking details of the PR (read-only)
events.triggered_when: User clicks the Menu icon near the desired PR Number and clicks Booking Query

events.description: Jumps to the selected section (Basic, Sailing, Requirements, PR, Cargo & Containers, Instruction, Marks & Desc, Addresses, EDI Text/Ref, More Info, Notes) without scrolling down manually
events.triggered_when: User clicks a section name in the section bar

events.description: Expands all sections in the Booking Query screen at once
events.triggered_when: User clicks the Expand All icon

events.description: Collapses all sections in the Booking Query screen at once
events.triggered_when: User clicks the Collapse All icon

events.description: Collapses the section where the icon is displayed
events.triggered_when: User clicks the Show Less icon in a section

events.description: Expands the section where the icon is displayed
events.triggered_when: User clicks the Show More icon in a section
